metas.name: Prisoners
metas.description: Directed by Denis Villeneuve (who also directed Sicario), this dark, high-stakes mystery features intense moral dilemmas and a gripping, atmospheric search for missing children that matches your love for Zodiac.

metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: This highly intellectual, emotionally resonant sci-fi drama deals with language and first contact, appealing to your appreciation for thought-provoking genre films like Ex Machina.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: An atmospheric, slow-burn historical horror film that matches the dread and period-appropriate tension of gothic horror movies like The Others.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: This mind-bending, low-budget sci-fi thriller features a dinner party disrupted by a cosmic anomaly, making it a perfect fit for fans of Exam, It's What's Inside, and My Dinner with Andre.

metas.name: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
metas.description: Featuring a surreal, unsettling atmosphere and dark psychological undercurrents, this film perfectly matches your taste for prestigious, offbeat, and challenging dramas like The Master.

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description: A dark, atmospheric psychological horror film starring Robert Pattinson and Willem Dafoe. Its intense descent into madness matches the complex character dynamics of The Master.

metas.name: Se7en
metas.description: A quintessential David Fincher gritty detective thriller with deep, dark themes, offering a perfect companion piece to Zodiac and Gone Girl.

metas.name: Annihilation
metas.description: Directed by Alex Garland (Ex Machina), this surreal sci-fi horror film offers psychological depth, high stakes, and terrifying encounters reminiscent of 28 Days Later.

metas.name: The Prestige
metas.description: A brilliantly constructed mystery thriller about rival magicians that demands total attention, matching the calculated plot-driven nature of Conclave and The Others.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: This gritty neo-western crime thriller offers unrelenting tension, high stakes, and a stellar performance by Javier Bardem, aligning with your love for Sicario.

metas.name: Her
metas.description: A brilliant exploration of artificial intelligence, loneliness, and human connection that pairs beautifully with the tech-philosophy of Ex Machina and The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: A lavish, atmospheric psychological mystery directed by Martin Scorsese that evokes the same gothic, untrusting vibes as The Others and Exam.

metas.name: The Menu
metas.description: A sharp, satirical horror-thriller about high society and gastronomy that delivers the pitch-black comedic beats of In Bruges and the enclosed tension of Exam.

metas.name: Upgrade
metas.description: A fast-paced, stylish sci-fi thriller featuring body-horror and high-tech action that appeals to fans of Ex Machina and The Running Man.

metas.name: 10 Cloverfield Lane
metas.description: A masterfully tense bottle thriller featuring outstanding performances, reminiscent of the localized, suspenseful environments of Exam and Good Boy.

metas.name: The Hateful Eight
metas.description: A dialogue-heavy, snowbound mystery thriller by Quentin Tarantino that combines the high-stakes tension of Inglourious Basterds with the confined cabin dynamics of Exam.

metas.name: Moon
metas.description: A quiet, isolationist sci-fi drama featuring a stellar performance by Sam Rockwell. It captures the philosophical, existential weight of Ex Machina and The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
metas.description: Another dark, meticulously crafted mystery from David Fincher. It matches the cold, procedural perfectionism of Zodiac and the psychological edge of Gone Girl.

metas.name: Under the Skin
metas.description: A deeply atmospheric, unsettling science fiction masterpiece that challenges the viewer, perfect for fans of existential and slow-burn mysteries.

metas.name: Hereditary
metas.description: An emotionally devastating, intense horror movie dealing with grief and supernatural dread. It's a gold standard for prestigious psychological horror like Smile 2.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description: From the director of In Bruges, this film reunites Colin Farrell and Brendan Gleeson for a brilliantly written, melancholic dark comedy about a broken friendship.

metas.name: Identity
metas.description: A tense, claustrophobic mystery about strangers trapped at a motel during a storm, carrying the same psychological paranoia seen in Exam.

metas.name: Oldboy
metas.description: An intense, high-stakes mystery thriller filled with jaw-dropping twists, gritty action, and psychological warfare that will appeal to fans of Gone Girl and Sicario.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description: A methodical, gripping investigative drama that demands focus, carrying the same procedural energy and institutional stakes as Conclave and Zodiac.

metas.name: Wind River
metas.description: Written and directed by Taylor Sheridan (writer of Sicario), this cold, relentless murder mystery thriller is deeply atmospheric and highly emotional.

metas.name: A Quiet Place
metas.description: A stellar creature-feature thriller focused on sound-deprived survival, matching the sheer suspense of 28 Days Later and The Abyss.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description: An intensely emotional and devastating mystery drama about siblings uncovering their mother's secret past in the Middle East, boasting Villeneuve's signature tension.

metas.name: Green Room
metas.description: A white-knuckle, gritty survival thriller about a punk band trapped in a green room by neo-Nazis. It matches the high-stress adrenaline of 28 Days Later.

metas.name: Primer
metas.description: An ultra-realistic, highly complex indie sci-fi mystery that demands full intellectual engagement, perfect for fans of Ex Machina and The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: The Invitation
metas.description: A slow-burn psychological thriller about a tense dinner party where nothing is as it seems, appealing to your love for Exam and It's What's Inside.

metas.name: Parasite
metas.description: The ultimate genre-bending dark comedy thriller. It is a masterpiece of tension, class dynamics, and unexpected twists that mirrors the narrative ingenuity of Gone Girl.

metas.name: Zero Dark Thirty
metas.description: From the director of The Hurt Locker, this intense war-thriller details the decade-long hunt for Osama bin Laden with relentless, high-stakes precision.

metas.name: A Ghost Story
metas.description: A quiet, profound, and artistically daring exploration of love, loss, and time that aligns with the emotional complexity of Only Yesterday and The Wind Rises.

metas.name: Brawl in Cell Block 99
metas.description: A gritty, uncompromising, and brutal crime drama that matches the uncompromisingly masculine tension and dark undertones of Gran Torino.

metas.name: The Game
metas.description: A twisty psychological thriller from David Fincher about a man whose life is turned upside down by an enigmatic game, fitting perfectly with Gone Girl.

metas.name: Decision to Leave
metas.description: A gorgeously filmed, complex romantic mystery/thriller about a detective obsessed with a suspect, mirroring the visual and emotional depth of Zodiac.

metas.name: Midsommar
metas.description: A deeply unsettling folk-horror film set in bright daylight that explores toxic relationships, delivering the psychological punch of Smile 2.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: A clever, highly entertaining whodunit with an exceptional cast that perfectly balances dark comedy and sharp mystery like Lucky Number Slevin.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description: A masterful, mind-bending anime psychological thriller about identity and paranoia that is just as intense and demanding as any live-action prestige thriller.
